correctness.rationale: Exact convolution density f_Z(z)=V^-1 product_i(1-|z_i|/a_i)_+; integration of its unclipped expansion over a radius-r ball yields gamma-coefficient formula. Volume and reciprocals elementary symmetric functions invert the first d terms uniquely. Simple-root perturbations prove generic sharpness of prefix length. Immediately after the shortest length, disjoint one-coordinate cap integrals and beta integration yield the strictly positive correction and controlled remainder for all d>=3. The independent 3D slicing check corroborated normalization. Limits: exact population data only and a fixed orthotope.
